Rooms.Name: The Wedding Chapel
Rooms.Description:
The walls inside the chapel glow with a divine light.  You feel at
ease inside here, all of your worries left at the door.  Rows of
cushioned silvery seats are here for your seating comfort.  Murals of
Elite's great gods line the walls, providing witness to this event.
Upon closer inspection, you realize the stained glass windows are
actually depictions of IO creating the very fabric of existance.  At
the far end of the room you see a magnificent altar constructed of an
unknown, but enchanting alloy. A beautiful silken canopy covers the
wedding platform, where the bride and groom to be will stand and speak
their vows.
§N

Rooms.Name: The Void
Rooms.Description:
You don't think that you are not floating in nothing. This is where IO dwelt
for an unimaginable time before he got this unimaginable idea of creating 
the universe.

Rooms.Name: Limbo
Rooms.Description:
You are floating in a formless void, detached from all sensation of physical
matter, surrounded by swirling glowing light, which fades into the relative
darkness around you without any trace of edges or shadow.

Rooms.Name: A totally useless room
Rooms.Description:
The walls are completely bare... no nothing at all in the room what so ever.
Strange ...

Exits.Description: You do not see that here.

Rooms.Name: The EliteMUD Correctional Institution.
Rooms.Description:
So this is what the inside of a jail cell looks like...
 ________________________________________________________________________
|.      .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .|
|.      .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .|
|.      .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .|
|.      .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .       .|
|________________________________________________________________________|

   Through this little window, you can see into the Temple, but alas, you are
here, and they cannot help you. You had better pray to what ever God put you
here and ask for forgiveness of your sins. For you shall be condemed to this
room until the POWERs that be decide that you are reformed enough to enter the
world of EliteMUD.

Rooms.Name: The Morgue
Rooms.Description:
This is the morgue, where frozen people go to die.  Please store frozen people
here to avoid cluttering jail.  If you like, have a beer from the fridge, but
don't touch the corpses!
§N

Rooms.Name: IO's residence
Rooms.Description:
You are in the most weirdest room you have ever seen. The room itself is
large.  Actually it's very large. You can't seem to see where is ends. (Or
how). This room contains little however. A large and neat bed in one part. A
large fridge in another. A bar with an Auto Bartender System, ABS(tm) is in
another place.  Music can be heard, but the source cannot be found. Naturally
there is a small computer somewhere around here where he codes when things gets
boring. There is also a poker table in one part.

Rooms.Name: The (Experimental?) Remort Lab
Rooms.Description:
This room is very clean, white tile floor, bright lights, you immediately
think of a laboratory.  Looking around, you see that it indeed is.  Flasks
line the shelves with various labels on them such as 'kick', 'sanctuary',
and the ever popular 'backstab' and 'circle' 2-pack.  Further down you
see some strange looking equipment and some vials labeled 'experimental',
one vial is jumping around. . .strange.  As you stray too near the
experimental section you are intercepted and guided to your seat.  Many
others, of whom you have only heard stories of their great exploits have
sat in this seat.  Will you join them in glory or become just another name
on a remort list?
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The vial is rather large and seems to move by some power within
There is a label on it... Experimental:  Whupass
§N

Rooms.Name: Outside the Wedding Chapel
Rooms.Description:
You seem to be floating in the heavens above Elite.  Directly below
you can see the town of Midgaard, the center of Elite.  Looking around you
can also see Welmar's castle and the fires of Hell dimly burning. You
wonder what mystical power protects you from falling to the earth below.
As you look around, the only thing visible is a white chapel in the
distance.  Two large golden doors and beautiful stained glass windows
decorate this magnificent building.  You conclude that this place must be
the creation of one of Elite's gods.  Putting aside the fear of plummeting
to your death below, you decide to approach the chapel to bear witness to
the events that are about to unfold.
§N

Rooms.Name: Inside the Wedding Chapel
Rooms.Description:
The golden doors mysteriously open, as if sensing your presence.
At first glance, the interior of this building is as beautiful as its
exterior.  Flowers gathered from the far reaches of Elite can be seen
here decorating the white walls.  Ahead of you a set of crystaline
doors can be seen.  These also open, as if they had a life of their
own.  Your first look at the actual chapel leaves you speechless.  
§N

Rooms.Name: Flower Garden
Rooms.Description:
You have wandered into a beautiful flower garden.  Every variety of
Elite foliage must be here growing and blossoming.  Looking around
you realize that the flowers form a heart-shape, with a single
golden swing in the middle.  The swing seems perfectly sized for two
people.  You inhale deeply and breath in the wonderful scents that
float around this garden.
§N

Rooms.Name: Dining Hall
Rooms.Description:
Inside the dining hall you see a gigantic room with foods of all
sorts.  Elite's finest chefs must have gathered and collaborated to
create such a magnificent feast for the eyes as well as the stomachs of
all.  At the head of the room you see a gigantic cake, fit for such an
occassion.  Next to the cake you see the table that belongs to the lucky
couple.  Through the many large glass doors you can see a balcony that
must provide a breathtaking view of the land below.
§N

Rooms.Name: Balcony
Rooms.Description:
Standing upon the balcony you can see virtually all of Elite below.
Through the clouds, characters the size of ants can be seen scurrying
around below, rushing from one zone to the next.  There appears to be
celebration all around you, including on the world below.  The news of
a wedding must have spread throught the realm.  Looking out above the
clouds, in the very distance you see the palace that contains the
homes of Elite's mighty gods.
§N

Rooms.Name: The Room that will be
Rooms.Description:
This is the room that is the one that will be something when you have decided
to do something about it,now that it has become something from nothing
